name: Roommate: Asami -Oku-sama wa Joshikousei-
original_name: ルームメイト・麻美 －おくさまは女子高生－
source:
As the newlywed husband of your student Onohara Asami, you live with your student bride and help her with homework as well as the rigors of living together and keeping the marriage a secret in school. 

[adapted from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=3360]AniDB[/url] and [url=http://www.shopncsx.com/roommateasami.aspx]NCSX[/url]]
